outreach_packet.subject_line: Live ops infrastructure + your Overwolf/AppLovin thesis
outreach_packet.hook: Following your investments in Overwolf and AppLovin, I wanted to share how we're solving the live operations crisis that plagues studios like those in your portfolio.

body_paragraphs.value_prop: We're building the definitive live operations platform for gaming studios—a unified system that replaces the fragmented tools studios currently duct-tape together. Just as Overwolf empowered creators and AppLovin transformed monetization, we're automating the entire live ops lifecycle: content deployment, player segmentation, event orchestration, and real-time balancing. Studios using our platform reduce live ops overhead by 60% while increasing player retention 25%.
body_paragraphs.market_insight: Your portfolio companies like Scopely and Second Dinner know that live services aren't just a revenue model—they're an operational nightmare. The average mid-size studio now spends $22M annually on third-party live ops infrastructure and headcount. With gaming revenues at $184B globally but development costs rising faster than monetization, studios are desperate for infrastructure that lets small teams operate like industry giants. This is the exact wedge that created AppLovin's $30B+ value.
body_paragraphs.traction_ask: We're currently in closed beta with 3 mid-size studios (NDAs prevent naming, but one has a top-100 mobile title) and seeing 40% reduction in content deployment time. Given Griffin's singular focus on gaming infrastructure and your track record with Overwolf and AppLovin, we'd welcome a conversation about our Seed round. Would you be open to a 20-minute call next week?
